run_bundle_adjustment: run the bundle adjustment example with synthetic dataset and Theseus optimizer
run_camera_loss: run the camera loss function to compute SE3 distance between optimized and ground truth poses
run_get_batch: run get_batch to clone original camera poses and 3D points for each optimization iteration
run_save_epoch: run save_epoch to persist optimization results including loss history and outputs to disk
run_print_histogram: run print_histogram to log a reprojection error histogram for the bundle adjustment dataset
